question: In a presentation competition, Group Leo can complete a task in 9 days, while Group Tiger can finish it in 18 days if they work alone. If both groups work together, in how many days will they complete the task?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use formula: (xy)/(x + y)

= (9 × 18)/(9 + 18)

= 162/27

= 6 days

**∴ Answer = 6 days**
